# TruthGuard: Multimodal Fake News Detection System

**TruthGuard** is an end-to-end multimodal fake news and misinformation detection platform. It processes diverse media formats—including video, audio, image, and raw text—using advanced transcription and OCR pipelines combined with Large Language Models via Groq to perform rapid fact verification and source analysis.

---

## Key Features

* **Multimodal Ingestion**:
* **Video Analysis**: Transcription and subtitle extraction using **WhisperX**.
* **Audio & Voice Processing**: Speech-to-text conversion via **Whisper**.
* **Image Processing**: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) using **PaddleOCR** to extract embedded text from banners, memes, and articles.
* **Text Processing**: Standard automated text cleaning and normalization.


* **High-Speed LLM Inference**:
* Leverages **Groq** cloud acceleration.
* Supports reasoning and synthesis models: **DeepSeek-R1** and **Llama 3 70B**.


* **Orchestration & Workflow**:
* Built with **LangChain** and **LangGraph** (agentic workflows / Anthropic MCP integration).


* **Web Interface**:
* Interactive frontend (HTML/CSS/JS) served via Python backend (`app.py`).


* **Containerized**:
* Docker support for repeatable deployment across local and cloud environments.



---

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
| --- | --- |
| **Backend & App** | Python, Flask/FastAPI (`app.py`), Setuptools (`setup.py`) |
| **Frontend** | HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (`templates/`, `static/`) |
| **Speech & Audio** | Whisper, WhisperX |
| **OCR** | PaddleOCR, OpenCV (Headless) |
| **LLM Provider** | Groq (Llama 3 70B, DeepSeek-R1, Whisper) |
| **Agent Frameworks** | LangChain, LangGraph |
| **Deployment** | Docker |
